title: GenAiEvalResult
description: One evaluation result sourced from a `gen_ai.evaluation.result` event on the parent GenAI span.

explanation.description:
`gen_ai.evaluation.explanation` - optional human-readable explanation.

The explanation is length-bounded at 4096 characters.

name.description: `gen_ai.evaluation.name` - required free-form identifier of the evaluation, such as `"factuality"`, `"safety"`, or `"toxicity"`.

response_id.description: `gen_ai.response.id` - optional link to the model response that was evaluated.

score_label.description: `gen_ai.evaluation.score.label` - optional categorical label, such as `"pass"`, `"fail"`, or `"borderline"`.

score_value.description:
`gen_ai.evaluation.score.value` - optional finite numeric score.

NaN and infinite values are rejected by [`GenAiEvalResult::validate`].
